obs-sat-1.webp.zh: 卫星视角：奥伯纳南阿尔代什机场（OBS）位于绿色植被与农田之中。
obs-sat-1.webp.en: Satellite view: Aubenas-South Ardèche Airport (OBS) lies among green vegetation and farmland.

obs-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 从空中俯瞰，一条跑道横卧在起伏的灌木山丘之间，浅色停机坪旁散落着几座低矮建筑。
obs-chatgpt-01.webp.en: Seen from the air, a single runway runs between rolling scrub-covered hills, with a pale apron and a few low buildings at its edge.

obs-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 绿色草地之间分布着白色塔台、几座机库和停放的轻型飞机，远处是连绵的蓝色山脉。
obs-chatgpt-02.webp.en: A white control tower, several hangars and light aircraft scattered on the grass stand in front of a long ridge of blue mountains.

obs-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 一架白色轻型飞机停在沥青地面上，远处山脊上覆着积雪，蓝天中飘着几缕白云。
obs-chatgpt-03.webp.en: A small white light aircraft rests on the tarmac with snow-streaked mountains rising behind and a few clouds in the blue sky.

obs-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 一架涂成红黄两色的双发涡桨飞机停在宽阔的停机坪上，舱门打开，登机梯已经放下。
obs-chatgpt-04.webp.en: A twin turboprop painted in red and yellow stands on the wide apron with its door open and boarding steps in place.

obs-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 阴沉的天空下，几十架轻型飞机密集地停放在草地与混凝土混合的场地上，几个人在机群间走动。
obs-chatgpt-05.webp.en: Under an overcast sky, dozens of light aircraft are parked closely together on grass and concrete while a few people wander among them.

obs-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 一架白橙相间的轻型飞机停在楼前的水泥地上，背景是单层的白色航站小屋和晴朗蓝天。
obs-chatgpt-06.webp.en: A white and orange light aircraft sits on concrete in front of a single-storey white terminal, under a cloudless blue sky.

obs-chatgpt-07.webp.zh: 绿网围栏前，几名游客望向栏内那架涂着红黄条纹的双发涡桨飞机，阳光很强烈。
obs-chatgpt-07.webp.en: Behind a green mesh fence, visitors look at a twin turboprop painted with red and yellow bands in bright sunshine.
